sentences.text: Eragon is a 2006 British-American action-fantasy film directed by Stefen Fangmeier -LRB- in his directorial debut -RRB- and written by Peter Buchman , based on the novel of the same name by Christopher Paolini .	Stefen Fangmeier	Stefen Fangmeier	Eragon	Eragon	Christopher Paolini	Christopher Paolini	Peter Buchman	Peter Buchman	action	action film	fantasy film	fantasy film	novel of the same name	Eragon

The film stars Ed Speleers in the title role as well as Jeremy Irons , Garrett Hedlund , Sienna Guillory , Robert Carlyle , John Malkovich , Djimon Hounsou , Alun Armstrong and Joss Stone , with Rachel Weisz as the voice of Saphira the dragon . Principal photography took place at the Mafilm Fót Studios in Hungary , starting on August 1 , 2005 .
Visual effects and animation were by Weta Digital and Industrial Light & Magic .	Weta Digital	Weta Digital	Industrial Light & Magic	Industrial Light & Magic
Eragon was released worldwide between December 13 and December 15 , 2006 by 20th Century Fox .	Eragon	Eragon	20th Century Fox	20th Century Fox
It was the 10th worst reviewed film of 2006 on Rotten Tomatoes , but the 31st highest-grossing film of 2006 in the US .	Rotten Tomatoes	Rotten Tomatoes
The film was released for home entertainment on March 20 , 2007 .
It is notable for being the last film to be released on VHS in the United States .	VHS	VHS
